path_a_remaining.residual_disposition: EXTERNAL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED. Each already carries a PARSED-tier RateRule citing a real figure, but the citation's source is a secondary aggregator (greenslate.com, shamelstudio.com, thereactionlab.com, vitrina.ai, rodriqueslaw.com, camaleonrental.com, innovires.com, saturation.io) rather than the administering government/official body itself, or explicitly discloses the figure as 'not contradicted this pass' / 'carried forward unchallenged' from an earlier unverified catalog entry. The exact indispensable proposition remaining for every one of these 37 is identical in kind: an independent direct engagement with the actual administering authority's own page/statute, reproducing or correcting the specific relied-on rate figure verbatim. Several were attempted this session via live WebFetch and found genuinely inconclusive rather than promoted on weak evidence -- at_fisa_plus (fisaplus.com homepage doesn't surface the rate), ca_federal_pstc (canada.ca returns 403 site-wide, blocking both PSTC and, by the same domain block, ca_federal_cptc in Path B), ae_ad_film_rebate (film.gov.ae 403), be_tax_shelter (finance.belgium.be describes the investor-side 310% exemption, a different figure than the producer-net 42-44% this engine models), pl_pisf_cash_rebate (pisf.pl 403 / polishfilmcommission.pl cert error), us_ky_keiia (revenue.ky.gov and the KAR administrative regulation confirm the $75M cap but never state the rate percentage itself), it_tax_credit_foreign (mestierecinema.it is fetched directly but is a private consultancy, not MiC/Cinecittà itself).

path_b_remaining.residual_disposition: EXTERNAL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED. Confirmed zero data of any kind (RateRule, DoctrineRecord, jurisdiction_comparison profile, or global_inventory catalog entry) across all four canonical data sources this project maintains, re-confirmed against the retained Codex historical-authority-source cross-reference (docs/validation/CODEX_HISTORICAL_AUTHORITY_SOURCE_CROSS_REFERENCE.json), which found 'No deleted authority/rule module' and no orphaned/unconsumed prior committee work for these slugs -- the absence is real, not an unwired-promotion gap like the 73/94 finding earlier in this task. The exact indispensable proposition for each is the program's basic economic nature and rate structure from first principles; several (in_national_film, mx_eficine_incentive, qc_film_production) additionally require resolving a genuine identity ambiguity (which specific sub-national program or mechanism the canonical_program_id represents) before any rate research is even well-posed -- disclosed in the original GLOBAL_ECONOMIC_DATA_ZERO_EVIDENCE_21.json entries, not re-derived here.
